The '''59th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] and television for 2001, were held on January 20, 2002.<ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globe winners|url=https://variety.com/2002/film/awards/golden-globe-winners-1117858810/|access-date=10 January 2018|work=Variety|date=20 January 2002|archive-date=December 6, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201206220219/https://variety.com/2002/film/awards/golden-globe-winners-1117858810/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Kidman and Crowe share Globes glory|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/1771610.stm|access-date=10 January 2018|work=BBC News|date=21 January 2002|archive-date=September 2, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250902081237/http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/1771610.stm|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Golden Globe Winners|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2002/01/22/arts/golden-globe-winners.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=22 January 2002|archive-date=February 5, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210205230717/https://www.nytimes.com/2002/01/22/arts/golden-globe-winners.html|url-status=live}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 20, 2001.<ref>{{cite news|title=‘Moulin,’ ‘Mind’ top Globe contender list|url=https://variety.com/2001/film/news/moulin-mind-top-globe-contender-list-1117857601/|access-date=10 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220429030024/https://variety.com/2001/film/news/moulin-mind-top-globe-contender-list-1117857601/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Allen|first1=Jamie|title=Globes: 'Beautiful,' 'Moulin' golden|url=http://edition.cnn.com/2001/SHOWBIZ/Movies/12/20/golden.globe.nominations/index.html|access-date=10 January 2018|work=CNN|date=20 December 2001|archive-date=May 20, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080520083855/http://edition.cnn.com/2001/SHOWBIZ/Movies/12/20/golden.globe.nominations/index.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite
